text: EasyJet disclosed it is evaluating a £5.7 billion acquisition proposal from Apollo Global Management while an existing proposal from Castlelake remains active through its offer period. The board stated it is no longer minded to recommend the Castlelake proposal. Multiple acquisition proposals simultaneously remain under consideration.

meta.note: Competing acquisition proposals coexist; no definitive ownership outcome has been established.

text: The International Energy Agency forecast global oil demand to decline by 1 million barrels per day year over year in 2026. The forecast assumes gradual recovery of tanker flows through the Strait of Hormuz while identifying continued uncertainty around that condition. Oil demand projections and expected market balance remain conditional within the published outlook.

meta.note: This entry logs the published forecast as an institutional state rather than observed physical demand.

text: Delta Air Lines reaffirmed its full-year earnings guidance and reported quarterly results above consensus estimates. Premium and main cabin revenue remained comparable, while reported revenue per available seat mile and cost per available seat mile both increased year over year. Higher airfare remained reflected in the carrier's reported operating performance.

meta.note: Reported financial results and forward guidance are presented together without altering the current operating state.

text: Circle received approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to operate as Circle National Trust. The charter authorizes direct management of reserves backing the company's regulated stablecoins under national trust bank status. The charter does not authorize commercial banking activities such as accepting deposits or making loans.

meta.note: The authorization changes the regulatory structure without expanding into commercial banking functions.

text: The president announced he would neither sign nor veto a housing bill previously passed by Congress. Under the constitutional presentment process, the bill remained eligible to become law upon expiration of the prescribed review period without a veto. Congressional approval of the legislation remained unchanged.

meta.note: The operative structural change is the use of the constitutional default enactment mechanism rather than affirmative signature.
